prompt:
LTZZZ skill iteration monthly review 2026-11. Draft only: you review my three proposals, you do NOT decide and do NOT edit files. Public-distributable.

FORMAT
- Planner deepseek: ONLY JSON {"summary":"<=100 chars","tasks":[{"seat":"claude","task":"<=1500 chars"}],"needs_gpt_decision":false,"reason":null}. One task, seat claude.
- Worker claude: ONLY a table: proposal_id | verdict(accept_draft|revise|reject) | <=20-word reason. No prose, no summaries, no file edits.

CURRENT SKILL (in scope, identical in all four dirs): skills/ltzzz-task-execution, SKILL.md sha256 prefix 38cbfec8bd49, 7479 bytes, mirrored to .github/.claude/.agents.

PROPOSALS
P1 ref-fidelity rule. Evidence: run 43533345000, worker invented refs mail-001..mail-013 that are absent from mail-backlog/latest.json and emitted fake <read_file> tags. Change: add one rule line requiring refs to be copied verbatim from the supplied set, and requiring explicit "unable_to_read" instead of fabricated read tags. Benefit: kills fabricated triage rows. Risk: longer prompt by ~40 words. Rollback: delete the line. Behavior change: yes.

P2 card length bounds. Evidence: run 43533152957 failed with invalid_deepseek_task because planner task string exceeded 3000 chars. Change: add explicit bound in task-card reference: planner task <=1500 chars, worker task <=3000, background goes in card body not in task string. Benefit: avoids whole-card rejection. Risk: terse tasks lose context. Rollback: revert the note. Behavior change: yes.

P3 rule-6 labeling. Evidence: daily prompts repeatedly warn rule 6 is an authorization clause, not a route, because seats misused it as a route reason. Change: state this once in SKILL.md as a standing interpretation rule rather than repeating per card. Benefit: fewer mislabels. Risk: duplication with prompt text. Rollback: remove the line. Behavior change: no.

Ask per proposal whether a draft patch is worth preparing for a GPT ruling. Do not claim effectiveness gains as proven.
